pack.title: Talked down by staff
pack.description: Ask for a factual explanation of a disputed charge.

scenarios.setting: A service representative keeps interrupting your explanation of a billing error.
scenarios.jab: You clearly don't understand how the bill works.
scenarios.goal: Ask for a factual explanation of a disputed charge.

replies.line: Please explain this charge and let me finish describing the discrepancy.
replies.why: It requests information and a chance to be heard without insulting the representative.
replies.delivery: Point to the exact charge and keep your pace slow enough to invite a specific answer.

replies.line: Explain this charge, please. Then hear me out.
replies.why: It identifies the needed sequence without debating your competence.
replies.delivery: Point to the exact charge and keep your pace slow enough to invite a specific answer.

replies.line: I may be missing something; could you walk me through this charge after I explain the mismatch?
replies.why: It allows for misunderstanding while retaining space for your evidence.
replies.delivery: Point to the exact charge and keep your pace slow enough to invite a specific answer.

replies.line: Let's give the numbers a turn to speak.
replies.why: A light phrase redirects both people from labels to the bill.
replies.delivery: Point to the exact charge and keep your pace slow enough to invite a specific answer.

followUp.line: I'm asking how that policy produced this specific charge.
followUp.why: It distinguishes a general policy explanation from the calculation you need.
followUp.delivery: Point to the exact charge and keep your pace slow enough to invite a specific answer.
